note: A passport first issued exactly on the second birthday is valid five years. Ten years from the twelfth birthday, which is also when the fee becomes the adult one. Under 2, the normal passport is free on a first issue and EUR 44 for a further one; the game, which doesn't yet tell the two apart, leaves that fee unknown.
